name: Maggie Goodlander
stance: Supports bipartisan AI guardrails legislation and tighter controls on AI chipmaking equipment going to China.

statements.text: Promoted the bipartisan MATCH Act to close loopholes China exploits in controls on AI chipmaking equipment, coordinated with allies.
As America’s tech leaders call for stronger guardrails, we are demanding Speaker Johnson to bring the House back into session, so we can get to work on bipartisan AI legislation.
